items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: I know on records you're the only trumpet player -- or one of the few trumpet players who soloed on a Louie Armstrong record.

ctx.x: Yes, take Louie's place and stand up.
How did you feel about that? You're the -- I know on records you're the only trumpet player -- or one of the few trumpet players who soloed on a Louie Armstrong record.
Yes, that's right. Well, but you know what -- the boys, you know, one don't know how you feel when guys look -- like resent you, you know. Why would they do that?
